1.name: Rejection is Amazing
1.overview: Lewis Foy finally lets loose as a presenter on his own show. Aptly titled The Lewis Foy Show, each half-hour episode delivers several hilarious segments in which Foy does what he does best: entertain. The Bell of the Week, Lewis Foy Hotline and Scouse Dubs Fact of the Week just some of the segments to this cult comedy podcast-style story time talk show series. Created, Written, Directed, Edited by and Starring Lewis Foy, featuring an array of stars.
